scenario.title: The Whispering Vault
scenario.premise: The abbey of Saint Corvin was abandoned in a single night. Kael has come for the sealed vault beneath it, and the abbot's study is the only room still lit.

study.name: the abbot's study
study.brief: A cramped room of ledgers and cold candle stubs; a loose flagstone hides something under the desk.

cloister.name: the cloister
cloister.brief: A frost-rimed colonnade around a dead garden; Brother Tomas sweeps it to no purpose.

bell_tower.name: the bell tower
bell_tower.brief: A cramped climb of rotten ladders above the nave, its bell long since stilled.

vault.name: the sealed vault
vault.brief: The undercroft chamber Kael came for, its door bearing a seal nobody living can read.

traits.name: Warded
traits.text: The seal answers a touch, and something behind the door answers with it.

mara.name: Mara
mara.brief: The abbey's last scribe, cautious and tired, still cataloguing books nobody will read.

tomas.name: Brother Tomas
tomas.brief: A deaf old porter who sweeps the cloister and knows almost nothing about the vault.

elena.name: Elena
elena.brief: The vault's former archivist, hiding in the bell tower; she alone remembers the sealing rite.

cloister_rat.name: a bloated rat
cloister_rat.brief: It has grown fat on the dead garden and does not run from a lantern.

vault_map.name: the vault map
vault_map.brief: A creased chart of the undercroft, marking a stair the abbey's own plans deny.

lantern.name: a guttering lantern
lantern.brief: A dented tin lantern whose flame will not hold still.

traits.name: Unsteady Lantern
traits.text: (gear) Its shifting light exposes seams and movement in deep shadow.

player.name: Kael
player.brief: A scarred relic-hunter who came to the abbey for what is sealed beneath it.

traits.name: Relic Hunter
traits.text: (skill) Kael knows how old sanctums conceal what matters.

traits.name: Marked by the Past
traits.text: (frailty) Old scars make certain memories hard to face.

traits.name: Listening
traits.text: (condition) Listening for the next shift of weight behind the door.

vault-seal.title: The sealed vault
vault-seal.note: Kael came for the vault and does not yet know where its door is.

the-abbey-emptied-in-one-night.text: The abbey emptied in a single night: meals were left half-eaten, doors left open, and no brother has been seen on the road since.

mara-catalogued-with-elena.text: Mara catalogued the vault ledgers beside Elena for two winters, until the night Elena went below alone and never came back up.

mara-confirmed-the-vault-door-has-not-op.text: Mara confirmed the vault door has not opened in thirty years.

effects.text: The seal answers a touch, and something behind the door answers with it.

vault-sighted.note: Kael has found the vault door. Press on what opening the seal will cost.

vault-charted.note: The chart marks the stair to the vault door. Press on what opening the seal will cost.

archivist-found.note: Elena remembers the rite that sealed the vault. Let her name her price for it.

cloister_rat.concept: A bloated rat that will not be driven off

lines.text: The iron handle does not turn.

history.prompt: I look for another way in.

lines.text: A flagstone by the wall sits proud of its neighbours.

history.prompt: I lever up the loose flagstone and listen at the vault door.

lines.text: The flagstone lifts. Beyond the door, something shifts its weight and waits.
